title: process_brain_for_printing
summary: This Python software prepares MRI-derived brain surfaces for 3D printing.
Its command-line tools prepare and merge surfaces, apply colours, and generate multi-material brain slabs.
The University of Malta Magnetic Resonance Imaging Platform (UMRI) also sells 3D-printed brain models. All proceeds support UMRI research efforts. Models are available for collection in Malta only.
